title.narrative: Lifesaving Multipurpose Cash Assistance to the most vulnerable populations in Deir ez Zor

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtOxfam will provide lifesaving and life sustaining humanitarian aid to 1,206 Households (HHs) (6,030 people) selected from the most vulnerable populations in Deir ez Zor city (Deir Ez Zor sub-district). Oxfam will distribute Multipurpose Cash Assistance (MPCA), ensuring that the recipients are able to immediately cover their most urgent needs. Each of the selected HH will receive a total of 5,229,600 SYP (approximately 384.5 USD) for the three instalments (including transportation costs for the instalment) through a contracted Financial Service Provider (FSP). This amount and number of instalments is in line with the latest Cash Working Group (CWG) recommendations, of which Oxfam is currently acting as co-chair. Oxfam has also informed the CWG of its interventions under this project in order to avoid any duplication of efforts with any other actors. Oxfam will also conduct Post Distribution Monitoring (PDM) to monitor the use of the MPCA, satisfaction as well as other criteria. Oxfam will establish/or work with the existing Local Community Committee (LCC) in the target locations, to identify most vulnerable HHs in Deir ez Zor city who are highly food insecure and have lost or cannot participate in the current livelihood base and cannot meet their basics needs. Oxfam has an established office (Eastern Hub) in Deir ez Zor, and field teams that enable the team to coordinate at both operational and technical level with other humanitarian actors and any relevant stakeholders at municipality level. Oxfam also has a pool of Field Support Personnel who are field based to support the program delivery. Full support teams are at the hubs level and the operations in full are being managed and operated at the hubs level, with support from the Country Office. Oxfam will directly implement this response. lt/pgt
